items.title: Lillian Hardin Armstrong Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: when I worked with him out to the Lorraine Garden

ctx.x: Kepard, I don't know, when I worked with him out to the Lorraine Garden, it was just five or six pieces and nothing was arranged, we just played. But he could really blow a trumpet. And he had a nice, clear, strong tone. I can
tell that from the record. But they say he was better in person.
